name: Inma no Meikyuu Hikyou no Chika Iseki ni Kodaibunmei no Injuu o Mita!!
original_name: 淫魔の迷宮 秘境の地下遺跡に古代文明の淫獣を見た!!
source:
A herd of erotic monsters deep inside the relic...
Laying egg, breeding... The fear of impregnation strikes the heroine's heart!!
The professor, the protagonist of this story, eventually found the hidden place where the monsters dwell... Would they come back alive?

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE017489.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
遗迹深处的一群色情怪物……产卵、繁殖……怀孕的恐惧冲击着女主角的心灵！！故事的主人公——教授，终于找到了怪物们栖息的隐秘之地……他们能活着回来吗？
